title: Shaharda yo‘l so‘rash va tushuntirish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida shahardagi joylarning nomlarini aytasiz, notanish odamdan muloyim shaklda yo‘l so‘raysiz, buyruq shakli va turn left/right, go straight on, opposite, next to iboralari bilan yo‘l tushuntirasiz va uyingizdan do‘konga yo‘lni aytib berasiz.

scenes.title: Shaharda yo‘l so‘rash
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! O‘n birinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda uyingiz, xonalar va narsalar qayerda turganini tasvirlashni o‘rgandik. Bugun uydan tashqariga chiqamiz: shahardagi joylarning nomlari, yo‘l so‘rash va yo‘l tushuntirish. Dars oxirida uyingizdan yaqin do‘konga yo‘lni ingliz tilida aytib bera olasiz.
scenes.say: Hello again! Today we go out into the city and learn how to ask for and give directions.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun shaharga chiqamiz va yo‘l so‘rash hamda tushuntirishni o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: Shahardagi joylar: birinchi qism

examples.t: The pharmacy is on this street.
I need a bank.

scenes.say_native: Shahardagi joylar. Bank — bank. Post office — pochta. Pharmacy — dorixona. Supermarket — supermarket. Bus stop — avtobus bekati. Station — vokzal yoki stansiya: bus station, train station. Hospital — kasalxona. Police station — politsiya bo‘limi. “Pharmacy” ni talaffuz qilishda “f” tovushi eshitiladi: “FAR-ma-si”. “Station” da urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda: STA-tion.
scenes.say: Bank, post office, pharmacy, supermarket, bus stop, station, hospital.
scenes.say_uz: Bank, pochta, dorixona, supermarket, avtobus bekati, vokzal, kasalxona.

scenes.title: Shahardagi joylar: ikkinchi qism

examples.t: The museum is in the centre.
Let's go to the cinema.

scenes.say_native: Yana joylar. Café — kafe. Restaurant — restoran. Hotel — mehmonxona. Park — park. Museum — muzey. Library — kutubxona. School — maktab. Cinema — kinoteatr. Market — bozor. Eslatma: “library” — kutubxona, “librarian” esa kutubxonachi. Kitob sotib olinadigan joy “bookshop”. Bu so‘zlar o‘zbekchadagi ko‘p so‘zlarga o‘xshash, lekin talaffuzi boshqa, shuning uchun eshitib takrorlang.
scenes.say: Café, restaurant, hotel, park, museum, library, school, cinema, market.
scenes.say_uz: Kafe, restoran, mehmonxona, park, muzey, kutubxona, maktab, kinoteatr, bozor.

scenes.title: Qayerga boramiz?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Har bir ish uchun qayerga borishni ayting. Birinchi: dori sotib olish uchun. Ikkinchi: kitob olish uchun. Uchinchi: film ko‘rish uchun. To‘rtinchi: xat jo‘natish uchun. Masalan: “I go to the bank.” Joyning nomi oldidan “the” qo‘yish va “to” predlogini unutmang.
scenes.say: Where do you go to buy medicine? To borrow a book? To watch a film? To send a letter?
scenes.say_uz: Dori sotib olish uchun qayerga borasiz? Kitob olish uchun? Film ko‘rish uchun? Xat jo‘natish uchun?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: dori uchun — pharmacy. Kitob uchun — library. Film uchun — cinema. Xat uchun — post office. To‘liq gapda: “I go to the pharmacy”. “Go” dan keyin harakat yo‘nalishi uchun “to” keladi, o‘zbekchadagi “-ga” qo‘shimchasi o‘rnida. Faqat “home” bilan “to” kerak emas: “I go home”, “to home” emas.
scenes.say: I go to the pharmacy. I go to the library. I go to the cinema. I go to the post office. I go home.
scenes.say_uz: Men dorixonaga boraman. Kutubxonaga boraman. Kinoga boraman. Pochtaga boraman. Uyga boraman.

scenes.title: Yaqin atrofda bormi?
board: Is there a bank near here?
Yes, there is. It's in Park Street.

examples.t: Is there a pharmacy near here?
examples.uz: Bu yerda yaqin joyda dorixona bormi?

examples.t: There is a café on the corner.

scenes.say_native: Oldingi darsda o‘rgangan “there is” tuzilmasi bu yerda ham kerak. Yaqin joyda nimadir borligini so‘rash uchun: “Is there a bank near here?” — bu yerda yaqin joyda bank bormi? “Near here” — shu yerning yaqinida. Javob: “Yes, there is. It’s in Park Street” yoki “No, sorry”. Bitta joy so‘ralsa “a bank”, aniq, ma’lum joy bo‘lsa “the bank”: “Where is the bank?”.
scenes.say: Is there a bank near here? Yes, there is. It's in Park Street.
scenes.say_uz: Bu yerda yaqin joyda bank bormi? Ha, bor. U Park ko‘chasida.

scenes.title: Buyruq shakli: yo‘l ko‘rsatish

examples.t: Go straight on for two minutes.
Turn right at the traffic lights.

scenes.say_native: Yo‘l ko‘rsatishda buyruq shakli, ya’ni imperativ ishlatiladi. Bu juda oson: ega aytilmaydi, faqat fe’lning oddiy shakli turadi. Go straight on. Turn left. Take the second street. Inkorda — “don’t” qo‘shiladi: Don’t turn left. O‘zbekchada fe’lga “-ing”, “-ib” qo‘shimchasi kerak: boring, buriling. Inglizchada esa “you” ni ham, “-s” ni ham qo‘shmaysiz. Fe’lning o‘zi yetarli va bu muloyim hisoblanadi.
scenes.say: Go straight on. Turn left. Turn right. Don't turn left. Take the second street.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri yuring. Chapga buriling. O‘ngga buriling. Chapga burilmang. Ikkinchi ko‘chaga buriling.

scenes.title: Yo‘nalish iboralari
board: go straight on · turn left / right
at the traffic lights · cross the road

examples.t: Take the second street on the left.
Cross the road.

scenes.say_native: Endi yo‘l tushuntirish iboralari. Go straight on — to‘g‘ri yuring. Turn left — chapga buriling. Turn right — o‘ngga buriling. Take the first street, take the second street — birinchi, ikkinchi ko‘chaga buriling. At the traffic lights — svetoforda. Cross the road — yo‘lni kesib o‘ting. Go past the bank — bankdan o‘tib ketasiz. Bu iboralar kombinatsiya qilinadi: Go straight on, then turn left at the traffic lights.
scenes.say: Go straight on. Turn left at the traffic lights. Take the second street on the right. Go past the bank. Cross the road.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri yuring. Svetoforda chapga buriling. O‘ng tomondagi ikkinchi ko‘chaga buriling. Bankdan o‘ting. Yo‘lni kesib o‘ting.

scenes.title: Turn left: predlog kerak emas
board: ✗ Turn to left. / Turn at left.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida “chapga burilish” deganda yo‘nalish qo‘shimcha bilan bildiriladi: chapga, o‘ngga. Inglizchada “turn left” va “turn right” da predlog kerak emas, “left” va “right” o‘zi ravish. Shuning uchun “turn to left” demaymiz. Lekin joyni aytganda “left” ot bo‘ladi va “on the left” deymiz: The bank is on the left. Ya’ni “turn left” bilan “on the left” ni farqlang.
scenes.say: Turn left. The bank is on the left. Turn right. The park is on the right.
scenes.say_uz: Chapga buriling. Bank chap tomonda. O‘ngga buriling. Park o‘ng tomonda.

scenes.title: Yo‘lni ayting
board: 3) Cross the road, then go past the bank
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Ekrandagi har bir qisqa ko‘rsatmani to‘liq gap qilib ayting. Birinchi: ikki daqiqa to‘g‘ri, keyin chapga. Ikkinchi: svetoforda o‘ngga. Uchinchi: yo‘lni kesib o‘ting, keyin bankdan o‘ting. Buyruq shaklidan foydalaning, “you” kerak emas. Masalan: “Go straight on for two minutes.”
scenes.say: Go straight for two minutes, then left. Right at the traffic lights. Cross the road, then pass the bank.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki daqiqa to‘g‘ri, keyin chapga. Svetoforda o‘ngga. Yo‘lni kesib o‘ting, keyin bankdan o‘ting.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Go straight on for two minutes, then turn left.
2) Turn right at the traffic lights.
3) Cross the road, then go past the bank.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: Go straight on for two minutes, then turn left. Turn right at the traffic lights. Cross the road, then go past the bank. “Then” — keyin, harakatlar tartibini bildiradi. “For two minutes” — ikki daqiqa davomida. Hammasi buyruq shaklida, ya’ni fe’l oddiy holatda, “you” siz. Agar “You go straight” desangiz ham tushunishadi, lekin buyruq shakli tabiiyroq va qisqaroq.
scenes.say: Go straight on for two minutes, then turn left. Turn right at the traffic lights. Cross the road, then go past the bank.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki daqiqa to‘g‘ri yuring, keyin chapga buriling. Svetoforda o‘ngga buriling. Yo‘lni kesib o‘ting, keyin bankdan o‘ting.

scenes.title: Joylashuv: opposite, next to, between

examples.t: The bank is opposite the park.
The café is between the bank and the post office.

scenes.say_native: Joyni aniqlash uchun yana iboralar. Next to — yonida. Opposite — qarama-qarshisida, ya’ni ko‘cha narigi tomonida. Between ... and ... — ikkitasining o‘rtasida. On the corner — burchakda. In front of — oldida, behind — orqasida, near — yaqinida. Masalan: The bank is opposite the park. The café is next to the bank. The pharmacy is on the corner. “Opposite” bilan “to” kerak emas.
scenes.say: The bank is opposite the park. The café is next to the bank. The pharmacy is on the corner.
scenes.say_uz: Bank parkning qarshisida. Kafe bankning yonida. Dorixona burchakda.

scenes.title: Next to va in front of to‘liq
board: ✗ The bank is next the park.
✓ The bank is next to the park.
✗ The café is in front the hotel.
✓ The café is in front of the hotel.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida bu so‘zlar qo‘shimcha: parkning yonida, mehmonxonaning oldida. Shuning uchun inglizchada ularning oxiridagi kichik so‘zlarni tushirib qoldirish ko‘p uchraydi. “Next the park” noto‘g‘ri, to‘g‘risi “next to the park”. “In front the hotel” ham noto‘g‘ri, to‘g‘risi “in front of the hotel”. Bu uch so‘zli iboralarni bir bo‘lak sifatida yodlab oling: next to, in front of.
scenes.say: The bank is next to the park. The café is in front of the hotel.
scenes.say_uz: Bank parkning yonida. Kafe mehmonxonaning oldida.

scenes.title: Xaritani tinglang
board: Park Street, chap tomon: bank, café, post office
1) What is between the bank and the post office?
3) What is next to the library?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Park ko‘chasini tasavvur qiling. Chap tomonda ketma-ket bank, kafe va pochta. O‘ng tomonda ketma-ket kutubxona, park va muzey. Bank kutubxonaning qarshisida. Savollar: bank bilan pochta o‘rtasida nima bor? Kafening qarshisida nima bor? Kutubxonaning yonida nima bor? Javobni to‘liq gap qilib ayting.
scenes.say: On Park Street, on the left, there is a bank, a café and a post office. On the right, there is a library, a park and a museum. What is between the bank and the post office? What is opposite the café? What is next to the library?
scenes.say_uz: Park ko‘chasida chap tomonda bank, kafe va pochta bor. O‘ng tomonda kutubxona, park va muzey bor. Bank bilan pochta o‘rtasida nima bor? Kafening qarshisida nima bor? Kutubxonaning yonida nima bor?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) The café is between the bank and the post office.
2) The park is opposite the café.
3) The park is next to the library.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: kafe bank bilan pochta o‘rtasida. Kafening qarshisida park bor. Kutubxonaning yonida ham park bor, ya’ni park kutubxona bilan muzey o‘rtasida. Agar savol “What is…?” bo‘lsa, javob “The café is…” kabi to‘liq gap yoki qisqacha “The café” bo‘lishi mumkin. Qarama-qarshi bo‘lgan juftliklar: bank va kutubxona, kafe va park, pochta va muzey.
scenes.say: The café is between the bank and the post office. The park is opposite the café. The park is next to the library.
scenes.say_uz: Kafe bank bilan pochta o‘rtasida. Park kafening qarshisida. Park kutubxonaning yonida.

scenes.title: Muloyim savollar
board: Excuse me, where is the bank?
Excuse me, how do I get to the station?
Could you tell me where the bank is?

examples.t: Excuse me, how do I get to the museum?
Could you tell me where the station is?

scenes.say_native: Notanish odamdan yo‘l so‘raganda muloyim bo‘lish kerak. Avval “Excuse me” — kechirasiz, deysiz. Keyin “Where is the bank?” yoki “How do I get to the station?” — vokzalga qanday boraman? Yana ham muloyim variant: “Could you tell me where the bank is?” — bank qayerdaligini ayta olasizmi? “Could you” — muloyim iltimos shakli, javobda “Sure” yoki “Of course”. Oxirida “please” qo‘shish ham yaxshi.
scenes.say: Excuse me, where is the bank? How do I get to the station? Could you tell me where the bank is?
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, bank qayerda? Vokzalga qanday boraman? Bank qayerdaligini ayta olasizmi?

scenes.title: Muloyim savoldagi so‘z tartibi
board: ✗ Tell me where the bank is.
✓ Could you tell me where the bank is?
✗ Could you tell me where is the bank?
scenes.say_native: Ikkita xato. Birinchisi: “Tell me where the bank is” deb buyruq berish. Bu qo‘pol eshitiladi. Notanish odamdan “Excuse me, could you tell me…” deb iltimos qiling. Ikkinchisi: “Could you tell me where is the bank?”. “Could you tell me” dan keyingi qismda gap tartibi oddiy bo‘ladi: “where the bank is”, savol tartibi emas. Eslab qoling: “where is the bank?” ning o‘zi savol, lekin iltimos ichida “where the bank is”.
scenes.say: Could you tell me where the bank is? Excuse me, how do I get to the museum?
scenes.say_uz: Bank qayerdaligini ayta olasizmi? Kechirasiz, muzeyga qanday boraman?

scenes.title: Muloyim savol bering
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Notanish odamdan yo‘l so‘rang. Uchta joy bor: pochta, dorixona va muzey. Har biri uchun bitta muloyim savol tuzing. Masalan birinchisi uchun: “Excuse me, where is the post office?” Ikkinchisi uchun “Could you tell me where…” bilan, uchinchisi uchun “How do I get to…” bilan boshlang.
scenes.say: Ask for the post office, the pharmacy and the museum. Use Excuse me, Could you tell me, and How do I get to.
scenes.say_uz: Pochta, dorixona va muzeyni so‘rang. Excuse me, Could you tell me va How do I get to dan foydalaning.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Excuse me, where is the post office?
2) Could you tell me where the pharmacy is?
3) How do I get to the museum?
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: Excuse me, where is the post office? Could you tell me where the pharmacy is? How do I get to the museum? Sizning gaplaringiz biroz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin va shu to‘g‘ri. Tekshiring: “Excuse me” bormi? “Could you tell me” dan keyin “the pharmacy is”, ya’ni oddiy tartibmi? Va “How do I get to” dan keyin “the museum”, “to” siz emasmi? Hammasi shunday bo‘lsa, savollaringiz muloyim va to‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: Excuse me, where is the post office? Could you tell me where the pharmacy is? How do I get to the museum?
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, pochta qayerda? Dorixona qayerdaligini ayta olasizmi? Muzeyga qanday boraman?

scenes.title: Masofa va ko‘chalar sanog‘i
board: Is it far? · It's near. / It's not far.
It's about five minutes on foot.
the first · the second · the third street

examples.t: Is it far?
It's a ten-minute walk.

scenes.say_native: Yo‘l so‘raganda masofa ham muhim. “Is it far?” — uzoqmi? Javob: “It’s near”, “It’s not far” yoki “It’s about five minutes on foot”, ya’ni piyoda taxminan besh daqiqa. Yana bir shakl: “It’s a ten-minute walk”. Ko‘chalarni sanash uchun tartib sonlar kerak: first, second, third. “Take the second street on the left” — chapdagi ikkinchi ko‘chaga buriling. Tartib son oldidan “the” turadi.
scenes.say: Is it far? No, it's about five minutes on foot. Take the second street on the left.
scenes.say_uz: U uzoqmi? Yo‘q, piyoda taxminan besh daqiqa. Chap tomondagi ikkinchi ko‘chaga buriling.

scenes.title: Transport: by va on foot
board: by bus · by taxi · by metro · by car

examples.t: It's ten minutes by bus.
I go to school on foot.

scenes.say_native: Transport vositasi bilan borish “by” bilan aytiladi: by bus, by taxi, by metro, by car. Bu yerda “the” yoki “a” ishlatilmaydi. Piyoda — “on foot”. Masalan: It’s ten minutes by bus. I go to school on foot. Agar aniq avtobusni nazarda tutsangiz: “Take bus number twelve” yoki “Take the metro”. Toshkent metrosi haqida gapirganda ham “the metro” deyishingiz mumkin.
scenes.say: It's ten minutes by bus. It's five minutes on foot. Take bus number twelve.
scenes.say_uz: Avtobusda o‘n daqiqa. Piyoda besh daqiqa. O‘n ikkinchi avtobusga o‘ting.

scenes.title: On foot va by bus
scenes.say_native: Ikkita xato. “By foot” noto‘g‘ri, o‘zbekchadagi “oyoqda” ni so‘zma-so‘z tarjima qilmang, “on foot” deng. Ikkinchi xato: “by the bus”. Transport turi umumiy aytilganda “the” kerak emas: “by bus”. Lekin “Take the bus” da “take” bilan “the” bor. Farqini eslang: “by” dan keyin artiklsiz, “take” dan keyin esa artikl bilan.
scenes.say: I go on foot. I go by bus. I take the bus.
scenes.say_uz: Men piyoda boraman. Avtobusda boraman. Men avtobusga o‘tiraman.

scenes.title: Maktabga qanday borasiz?
board: 1) How do you get to school?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. O‘zingiz haqingizda javob bering. Birinchi: maktabga yoki ishga qanday borasiz? Ikkinchi: bu qancha vaqt oladi? Uchinchi: uzoqmi? Masalan: “I go to work by bus. It’s about twenty minutes. It’s not far.” “By bus”, “on foot” yoki “by metro” dan to‘g‘risini tanlang.
scenes.say: How do you get to work or school? How long does it take? Is it far?
scenes.say_uz: Ishga yoki maktabga qanday borasiz? Qancha vaqt oladi? Uzoqmi?

scenes.title: Namuna javoblar
scenes.say_native: Namuna javoblar: I go to work by bus. It’s about twenty minutes. No, it isn’t far. Sizning javobingiz “on foot” yoki “by metro” bo‘lishi mumkin. “How long does it take?” savoliga javob odatda “It takes twenty minutes” yoki “About twenty minutes”. Bu yerda oldingi darsdagi Present Simple ishlatildi: “How do you get”, “does it take”. Savollar tuzilishi yangi emas.
scenes.say: I go to work by bus. It takes about twenty minutes. No, it isn't far.
scenes.say_uz: Men ishga avtobusda boraman. Taxminan yigirma daqiqa oladi. Yo‘q, uzoq emas.

scenes.title: Birinchi dialog: vokzalga yo‘l
board: Where? Straight how long? Left or right? Far?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog. Turist notanish odamdan vokzalga yo‘l so‘raydi. Tinglab bo‘lgach, to‘rtta savolga javob bering: turist nimani qidiryapti? Qancha to‘g‘ri yurish kerak? Qayerga burilish kerak? Vokzal uzoqmi? Uzoq emas deb aytganini yoki aytmaganini diqqat bilan eshiting.
scenes.say: Excuse me, could you tell me where the station is? Yes, of course. Go straight on for two minutes. Then turn left at the traffic lights. The station is on the right, next to the hotel. Is it far? No, it's about five minutes on foot. Thank you very much! You're welcome.
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, vokzal qayerdaligini ayta olasizmi? Albatta. Ikki daqiqa to‘g‘ri yuring. Keyin svetoforda chapga buriling. Vokzal o‘ng tomonda, mehmonxonaning yonida. Uzoqmi? Yo‘q, piyoda taxminan besh daqiqa. Katta rahmat! Arzimaydi.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) What is the tourist looking for?
2) How long does he go straight?
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: turist nimani qidiryapti? Ikkinchi: qancha vaqt to‘g‘ri yuradi? Uchinchi: qayerga burilishi kerak? To‘rtinchi: vokzal qayerda, nimaning yonida? Javoblarni to‘liq gap bilan ayting, masalan: “He looks for the station.” Predloglarga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: What is the tourist looking for? How long does he go straight? Where does he turn? Where is the station?
scenes.say_uz: Turist nimani qidiryapti? Qancha to‘g‘ri yuradi? Qayerga buriladi? Vokzal qayerda?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 4) On the right, next to the hotel.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: turist vokzalni qidiryapti. Ikki daqiqa to‘g‘ri yuradi. Svetoforda chapga buriladi. Vokzal o‘ng tomonda, mehmonxonaning yonida. Masofa haqida: “about five minutes on foot”, ya’ni piyoda taxminan besh daqiqa. Dialog oxirida “Thank you very much” — katta rahmat, va javobi “You’re welcome” — arzimaydi, deyildi. Bu ikki iborani doim ishlating, ayniqsa notanishlar bilan.
scenes.say: The station. Two minutes. Left at the traffic lights. On the right, next to the hotel.
scenes.say_uz: Vokzal. Ikki daqiqa. Svetoforda chapga. O‘ng tomonda, mehmonxonaning yonida.

scenes.title: Rahmat va tushunmaslik
board: Thank you very much. · You're welcome.
Sorry, I don't know. I'm not from here.

examples.t: Could you repeat that, please?
Sorry, I'm not from here.

scenes.say_native: Yo‘l so‘raganda ba’zan tushunmay qolasiz. Shunda: “Could you repeat that, please?” — takrorlay olasizmi? Yoki “Slowly, please” — sekinroq, iltimos. Agar sizdan so‘rashsa va bilmasangiz: “Sorry, I don’t know. I’m not from here.” — kechirasiz, bilmayman, men bu yerlik emasman. Yo‘l tushuntirib berganlarga: “Thank you very much”. Javob: “You’re welcome” yoki “No problem”.
scenes.say: Could you repeat that, please? Slowly, please. Sorry, I'm not from here. Thank you very much.
scenes.say_uz: Takrorlay olasizmi? Sekinroq, iltimos. Kechirasiz, men bu yerlik emasman. Katta rahmat.

scenes.title: Eng yaqin joy
board: Is there a café near here?
It's the first building on the right.

examples.t: Where is the nearest pharmacy?
It's the first building on the left.

scenes.say_native: Ko‘pincha bizga istalgan joy emas, eng yaqini kerak. Buning uchun “the nearest” deymiz: Where is the nearest pharmacy? — eng yaqin dorixona qayerda? Bunda “nearest” dan oldin “the” turadi. Javobda ko‘pincha “It’s the first building on the right” — o‘ng tomondagi birinchi bino, deyiladi. Bu o‘zbekchadagi “eng yaqin” iborasiga mos keladi, faqat inglizchada “the” ni unutmang.
scenes.say: Where is the nearest pharmacy? It's the first building on the left.
scenes.say_uz: Eng yaqin dorixona qayerda? U chap tomondagi birinchi bino.

scenes.title: Tinglash uchun kalit so‘zlar
board: opposite · next to · on the corner
scenes.say_native: Yo‘l tushuntirilganda hamma so‘zni tushunish shart emas. Faqat kalit so‘zlarga quloq soling: left yoki right, straight, first yoki second, past va joyning nomi. Ularni ketma-ketlikda xotirangizda saqlang yoki qog‘ozga yozing. Agar tushunmasangiz, uyalmang: “Sorry, could you repeat that, please?” deng. Inglizlar sekin va aniq takrorlashdan hech qachon xafa bo‘lmaydi.
scenes.say: Listen for left, right, straight, first, second and past. You can say: Could you repeat that, please?
scenes.say_uz: Left, right, straight, first, second va past so‘zlariga quloq soling. Takrorlay olasizmi, deb so‘rashingiz mumkin.

scenes.title: Tartib bilan tushuntirish

examples.t: You can't miss it.
It's on your left.

scenes.say_native: Murakkabroq yo‘lni tushuntirganda so‘zlarni tartib bilan bog‘lang. First — avval, then — keyin, after that — undan keyin, finally — oxirida. “It’s on your left” — u chap tomoningizda. Yana foydali ibora: “You can’t miss it” — uni ko‘rmay qolmaysiz, ya’ni u juda ko‘zga tashlanadi. Masalan: First, go straight on. Then turn left. After that, the bank is on your right. You can’t miss it.
scenes.say: First, go straight on. Then turn left. The bank is on your right. You can't miss it.
scenes.say_uz: Avval to‘g‘ri yuring. Keyin chapga buriling. Bank o‘ng tomoningizda. Uni ko‘rmay qolmaysiz.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi dialog: kutubxonaga yo‘l
board: Where? Past what? Which street? Where is it?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog, bu biroz uzunroq. Anna kutubxonaga yo‘l so‘raydi. Tinglab bo‘lgach, uchta savolga javob bering: avval nimadan o‘tish kerak? Qaysi ko‘chaga, qaysi tomonga burilish kerak? Kutubxona qayerda, nimaning qarshisida? Har bir qadamni ketma-ketlikda eslab qoling.
scenes.say: Excuse me, how do I get to the library? First, go straight on and go past the post office. Then take the second street on the right. The library is on the left, opposite the museum. Is it far? No, it's a five-minute walk. You can't miss it. Thank you! No problem.
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, kutubxonaga qanday boraman? Avval to‘g‘ri yuring va pochtadan o‘ting. Keyin o‘ng tomondagi ikkinchi ko‘chaga buriling. Kutubxona chap tomonda, muzeyning qarshisida. Uzoqmi? Yo‘q, besh daqiqalik yo‘l. Uni ko‘rmay qolmaysiz. Rahmat! Arzimaydi.

scenes.title: Yo‘lni qaytaring
board: 2) Then take the ... street on the ...
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: avval nima qilish kerak, nimadan o‘tish kerak? Ikkinchi: keyin qaysi ko‘chaga, qaysi tomonga buriladi? Uchinchi: kutubxona qayerda? Javobingizni ekrandagi gap tuzilmasiga solib, to‘liq ayting. Dialogdagi so‘zlarni eslang: past, second, right, opposite.
scenes.say: What do you do first? Which street do you take? Where is the library?
scenes.say_uz: Avval nima qilasiz? Qaysi ko‘chaga buriladi? Kutubxona qayerda?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Go straight on and go past the post office.
2) Take the second street on the right.
3) It is on the left, opposite the museum.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: avval to‘g‘ri yurasiz va pochtadan o‘tasiz. Keyin o‘ng tomondagi ikkinchi ko‘chaga burilasiz. Kutubxona chap tomonda, muzeyning qarshisida. E’tibor bering, o‘ngga burilgandan keyin kutubxona chapda ekan. Bu g‘alati emas: ko‘cha ichida chap va o‘ng tomon sizning yo‘nalishingizga bog‘liq. “Past” — yonidan o‘tib, “opposite” — qarama-qarshisida.
scenes.say: Go straight on past the post office. Take the second street on the right. The library is on the left, opposite the museum.
scenes.say_uz: Pochtadan o‘tib to‘g‘ri yuring. O‘ng tomondagi ikkinchi ko‘chaga buriling. Kutubxona chap tomonda, muzeyning qarshisida.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: left va right
scenes.say_native: Talaffuzda e’tibor bering. O‘zbek tilidagi “r” tilning uchi titrab chiqadi. Ingliz “r” tovushida til titramaydi, til biroz orqaga tortiladi va tanglayga tegmaydi. “Right” — “rayt”, “left” — “left”. “Straight” — “streyt”, “g” o‘qilmaydi. Tez nutqda “could you” — “kudju” kabi eshitiladi. “Excuse me” da urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: ex-CUSE me. Mashq qiling.
scenes.say: Left. Right. Straight. Excuse me. Could you tell me?
scenes.say_uz: Chap. O‘ng. To‘g‘ri. Kechirasiz. Ayta olasizmi?

scenes.title: Takrorlang
board: Excuse me, could you tell me where the bank is?
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. Avval qisqa buyruqlar, keyin muloyim savol. Turn left, turn right, go straight on. Keyin to‘liq savol. “R” da tilni titratmang, “straight” da “g” ni aytmang. Savolni tabiiy ritmda ayting: “Excuse me” dan keyin biroz to‘xtab, keyin “could you tell me where the bank is?” ni bir nafasda.
scenes.say: Turn left. Turn right. Go straight on. Excuse me, could you tell me where the bank is?
scenes.say_uz: Chapga buriling. O‘ngga buriling. To‘g‘ri yuring. Kechirasiz, bank qayerdaligini ayta olasizmi?

scenes.title: Yo‘l tushuntiring
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Siz Park ko‘chasining boshida turibsiz. Chap tomonda ketma-ket bank, kafe va pochta bor. Notanish odam sizdan pochtaga yo‘lni so‘raydi. Unga yo‘lni tushuntiring. Avval to‘g‘ri yurish, qaysi joylardan o‘tish va pochta qaysi tomonda ekanini ayting. “First”, “then”, “past” so‘zlaridan foydalaning.
scenes.say: Excuse me, how do I get to the post office?
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, pochtaga qanday boraman?

scenes.title: Javob namunasi
board: Go past the bank and the café.
The post office is on the left. You can't miss it.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: First, go straight on. Go past the bank and the café. The post office is on the left, next to the café. You can’t miss it. Bu yerda burilish kerak emas, chunki pochta shu ko‘chaning o‘zida. Sizning javobingizda ham pochta chap tomonda ekani aytilishi kerak. Ko‘rsatmalar buyruq shaklida va tartib bilan bo‘lsa, yo‘l tushunarli bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: First, go straight on. Go past the bank and the café. The post office is on the left. You can't miss it.
scenes.say_uz: Avval to‘g‘ri yuring. Bank va kafedan o‘ting. Pochta chap tomonda. Uni ko‘rmay qolmaysiz.

scenes.title: O‘z yo‘lingizni tushuntiring
board: Where are you? (my home / the station)
scenes.say_native: Eng muhim mashq. Uyingizdan yaqin do‘konga yo‘lni ingliz tilida aytib bering. Avval do‘kon qayerda ekanini ayting, masalan, uyingizdan uzoqmi yoki yaqinmi. Keyin buyruq shaklida yo‘lni ketma-ket tushuntiring: to‘g‘ri yuring, buriling, nimadan o‘ting. Oxirida do‘kon qaysi tomonda ekanini ayting. Pauza paytida baland ovozda gapiring.
scenes.say: Now give directions from your home to a shop near you. Use first, then, turn, go past and it's on the left or right. Start!
scenes.say_uz: Endi uyingizdan yaqin do‘konga yo‘lni tushuntiring. First, then, turn, go past va chap yoki o‘ng tomonda so‘zlarini ishlating. Boshlang!

scenes.title: Namuna yo‘l tushuntirish
board: The shop is near my home.
First, go straight on for two minutes.
Then turn right at the traffic lights.
The shop is on the left, next to the pharmacy.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: The shop is near my home. First, go straight on for two minutes. Then turn right at the traffic lights. The shop is on the left, next to the pharmacy. It’s about five minutes on foot. Sizning yo‘lingiz boshqacha. Asosiysi: buyruq shakli, ketma-ketlik so‘zlari, to‘g‘ri predloglar va oxirida masofa. Yo‘l tushuntirish shu tartibda sodir bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: The shop is near my home. First, go straight on. Then turn right. The shop is on the left, next to the pharmacy.
scenes.say_uz: Do‘kon uyimga yaqin. Avval to‘g‘ri yuring. Keyin o‘ngga buriling. Do‘kon chap tomonda, dorixonaning yonida.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: Go straight on · Turn left / right · Take the second street
Excuse me, could you tell me where ... is?
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Shahardagi joylar nomlarini o‘rgandik. Yo‘l ko‘rsatish uchun buyruq shaklini ishlatishni bildik: go straight on, turn left, turn right. “Turn left” da predlog kerak emas, joyni aytganda esa “on the left” deymiz. Opposite, next to, between, near iboralari bilan joylashuvni aytdik. Muloyim savol: “Excuse me, could you tell me where the bank is?”. Masofa uchun “on foot”, “by bus”.
scenes.say: Great work! Now you can ask for and give directions in a city.
scenes.say_uz: Zo‘r ish! Endi shaharda yo‘l so‘ray va tushuntira olasiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Give directions from your home to a nearby shop
Use: First, Then, Turn, Go past, It's on the ...
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Uyingizdan yaqin do‘konga yo‘lni ingliz tilida tushuntiring: yozing yoki telefoningizga ovoz yozing. Kamida olti-sakkizta gap bo‘lsin. Ularda buyruq shakli, “first” va “then”, “turn left” yoki “turn right”, bitta joylashuv iborasi va masofa bo‘lsin. Tekshiring: “turn to left” yo‘qmi, “next to” va “in front of” to‘liqmi? Keyingi darsda ranglar, kiyim va do‘konda xarid qilishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Give directions from your home to a shop. See you next time. Bye!
scenes.say_uz: Uyingizdan do‘konga yo‘lni tushuntiring. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz. Xayr!

homework_uz: Uyingizdan yaqin do‘konga yo‘lni ingliz tilida tushuntiring (yozma yoki ovoz yozuvi, 6–8 gap). Mezon: buyruq shakli (Go..., Turn...); First/Then ketma-ketligi; turn left/right (to left emas) va on the left/right; kamida bitta next to, opposite yoki between; masofa (on foot / by bus).

options: Turn to left at the lights.
quiz.why_uz: Turn left — predlog kerak emas; buyruq shaklida fe’l oddiy holatda.
Qarshisida — opposite. In front va next bilan of va to kerak, opposite bilan esa kerak emas.
